new_targets.B1: Recovery of author-reconstructed nontrunk clusters supported by at least three branch-owned measured variants; metastatic/relapse identity is scorer-only when mapping exists.
new_targets.B2: Patient-averaged target recovery under frozen hypothetical acquisition costs; action utility is an explicitly new patient-level bridge.
new_targets.B3: Surgical-only marker selection followed by count-level replay on actual postoperative plasma; not FASTQ reprocessing or evidence of treatment benefit.

scope: New biological predictions and acquisition validation; CTMC parameters are not tree ancestry, clone fitness or recurrence hazard truth.
same_family_overlap: TRACERx tissues, metastases and plasma share patients; count one family and split all modalities by patient.
primary_population: LUAD patients with at least three surgical primary regions, no exclusion by hidden drivers, branch abundance, recurrence or model success.
secondary_population: All NSCLC histologies under the same prespecified eligibility and patient deduplication.
tumour_selection: Most available surgical primary regions per patient; tie lexicographic tumour_id. Histology derives from selected tumour.

reference_rules.missing: Not recorded/not callable is not biological absence; known-variant negatives at registered depth are reference detection only.

core_state: Recorded nonsynonymous SNV/indel union across primary regions; a surrogate reference state, not naturally observed generator truth.
narrow_observation: Actual recorded variants in the four gene mask; no imputation of unmeasured genes.
full_observation: Actual WES variant records in the revealed primary region; does not reveal hidden regions or their clusters.

acquisition.cost_status: Frozen hypothetical cost units, not measured monetary costs or actual prospectively acquired sequencing.
acquisition.region_order: Patient-keyed frozen random order, never chosen using hidden genotype or sequencing-derived QC.
acquisition.repeat_unit: Average perturbations within patient; not five independent patients.
acquisition.fit_sources: Only development full records for prior/operator/utility fit; confirmation actions frozen before revealing their outcomes.
acquisition.primary_endpoint: Additional nontrunk reference branches recovered divided by all eligible supported nontrunk reference branches; zero eligible branches contribute zero recovery, capacity counts also reported.
secondary_endpoints: metastatic branch recovery when actual mapping exists
acquisition.classical_baselines: All feasible fixed plans, development-best fixed plan, empirical-prior bridge, direct regularized utility fit, random feasible plan.
acquisition.CTMC_scope: Independent development reference-state snapshot fit and regional detection kernel inform patient predictions; branch utility requires a separate learned map. No clinical/ancestry interpretation of theta.

ctdna.selection_information: Only surgical primary tissue markers and original primary-only reconstructed clusters. No future plasma counts, clone_present flags, recurrence sites or outcomes.
ctdna.replay: Actual mutation-level UMI alt/total depth and frozen pipeline error annotations; record-count algorithm replay, not original published MRD replication.
ctdna.normal_calibration: Normal controls are separate; assay rule frozen in a supplemental protocol before any patient outcome replay.
ctdna.primary_endpoint: Detection of independently supported postoperative nontrunk clones at fixed marker budget and registered error control, with patient denominators.
secondary_endpoints: false-positive rate in held-out normal controls
ctdna.incomplete_rule: If actual counts, normal error controls, primary-only marker mapping or timelines cannot be verified, do not substitute invented measurements.

inference.primary_comparisons: Three acquisition methods vs development-best fixed under primary budget/overhead, two-sided patient paired test; Holm family size3. Plasma families frozen separately before replay.
inference.zero_denominator: Retain patients and explicitly identify denominator-free reference cases; never select by a positive outcome.
inference.interpretation: Confidence intervals conditional on the frozen development fits. No population-natural theta coverage claims.

adoption: Publish a new main figure only for a supported, explicitly scoped new endpoint; compare against strong controls. Unsupported new claims remain described in the research report and do not overwrite older valid results.

plots.review: Actual screenshots and actual exports reviewed, no automated user-approval flags.
plots.failed_figures: No failed exploratory render in formal release.

wetlab: Optional isogenic perturbation is not executable in this computational environment. No wet-lab result will be claimed.
